fallbacks.docker_denied: No escalation/questions; static source research and owned standard-library prototypes.
fallbacks.local_inference_unavailable: Preserve exact reason; no external inference or unchanged repeat.

checkpoint_policy: Approximately every 30 minutes and critical results; include bytes, modes, source identities and actual restore evidence. No artificial waits.
